capabilities.description: A time block: a start and an end, set together and in order. Given one, the other takes its value.
The calendar day of a journal entry. A workspace has one entry per day.
A due time, a reminder time, or both.
One of the workspace's statuses. It tracks something written down.

taxonomy.description: At most one category, at most one subcategory of that category, and any number of tags, all from the item's workspace.

kinds.description: Text that is tracked by a status.
An item with a time block.
The journal entry of one day.

rules.kinds: A kind is computed from what the item holds and never stored. An item can be several kinds at once, and it stops being a kind when a capability that kind holds is removed.

create.idempotency: A create may name the item's uid. Repeating it stores nothing and answers 200 with the stored item instead of 201.

update.version: expectedTimeModified names the timeModified the caller last saw. A stale one writes nothing and answers 409 with the stored item.
update.contentRequired: An update that would leave the item with no content is refused with content_required. Delete the item instead.
update.requirementMissing: An update that would leave a state without a capability it requires is refused with requirement_missing. Clear that state in the same request.

delete.version: A delete may name expectedTimeModified. A stale version leaves the item in place and answers 409 with the stored item.
delete.vocabulary: Deleting an item removes each category, subcategory, and tag that no item uses any more. Statuses and the workspace are kept.
